translation_notes: context shim infixowl_context.py: the region is one method of a vendored copy of rdflib.extras.infixowl; Individual and Property (needed by super(Property, self)) are re-exported from the installed rdflib.extras.infixowl (identical names/signatures); imported identically by both sides

prefix owl: declared instead of the mechanical owl-ns:: a hyphenated prefix is usable inside islands only, and here the prefixed name appears OUTSIDE any island (default argument baseType=owl:ObjectProperty), where - stays subtraction
OWL_NS = Namespace(...) dropped on the ldpy side: @prefix absorbs both of its uses (the default argument and the type term)
the rdflib import block is kept verbatim on both sides even though RDF/RDFS are no longer read on the ldpy side

prefixed names read naturally in non-island positions: baseType=owl:ObjectProperty as a def default, and (self.identifier, rdf:type, baseType) not in self.graph as a membership test (no island exists for reads, which is fine here since the tuple is what rdflib expects)
graph.add((s, RDF.type, baseType)) -> graph += g{ {s} a {baseType} }; the object stays an interpolation because it is a parameter

driver: Probe is a Property subclass with an inert constructor so the lifted __init__ can be called on a real Property instance; four fixtures cover the default baseType, an explicit one, the already-asserted guard and the baseType=None introspection branch
